Ryan Holt (10:02 A.M.)

아직 한 가지를 기다리고 있어요. 시에서는 신청서의 모든 부분을 동시에 제출하도록 요구해요. Delgado 씨가 부지 측량 자료와 예산서는 보내 주셨는데, 건축가에게서 서명된 평면도를 아직 받지 못했어요.

그럼 그것 없이는 시에서 신청서를 검토하지 않는 건가요?

Sunny Side Bakery
Staff Guidelines
Timekeeping
· If you will be late or unable to come in, call your supervisor at least two hours before your shift begins.
· Scan your ID badge at the front terminal when you arrive and again when you leave.
· If you work the closing shift, you may not be able to scan out while the terminal is saving the day's sales records.
· If this happens, write your departure time on the paper log by the back door. Your supervisor will enter it into the system the next morning. On your next shift, make sure that it was entered correctly.
· If you want to swap shifts with another employee or take a vacation day, get your supervisor's approval at least one week ahead.

근무 시간 기록

· 도착할 때와 퇴근할 때 앞쪽 단말기에 사원증을 스캔하세요.
